nodes.title: Continuum — docs/ai/CURRENT_STATE.md
nodes.summary: Current human/agent Continuum state route for E0, Pilot/Evidence boundaries, and lifecycle gates.
nodes.why_read: Open for current Continuum lifecycle state, then consult machine state and exact owner decision artifacts for gated transitions.

nodes.title: Continuum — project-state.json
nodes.summary: Machine-readable Continuum lifecycle checkpoint including Pilot and evidence readiness/authorization flags.
nodes.why_read: Open for deterministic lifecycle flags such as Pilot NOT_AUTHORIZED; do not treat machine state as an owner decision substitute.

nodes.title: Continuum — OD-PILOT-01 Owner Decision Packet
nodes.summary: Owner-decision packet defining the bounded prerequisites and explicit non-authorization state around a future Pilot transition.
nodes.why_read: Open when evaluating whether a Pilot transition has actually been adopted; the packet itself records prerequisites and does not grant the transition.

nodes.title: Continuum — STATUS.md
nodes.summary: Human-oriented current status explanation that must be read with the authoritative machine state and live repository.
nodes.why_read: Open for a readable Continuum checkpoint; machine state and owner decision artifacts control gated lifecycle semantics.

nodes.title: CLOS — docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md
nodes.summary: Current CLOS research status and bounded frontier/closure routing.
nodes.why_read: Open first for current CLOS research posture before following individual fixtures, evidence records, or older hypotheses.

nodes.title: CLOS — CLOS_BLUEPRINT.md
nodes.summary: Substrate-neutral cognitive research blueprint used to frame functions and distinctions independently of a specific LLM/runtime implementation.
nodes.why_read: Open for substrate-neutral cognitive obligations and framing; route implementation questions to Cognitive OS or the owning project.

nodes.title: CLOS — EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md
nodes.summary: Research evidence ledger recording what CLOS findings are supported, limited, contradicted, or still unresolved.
nodes.why_read: Open to trace evidence behind CLOS claims and their limitations rather than relying on summary prose alone.

nodes.title: CLOS — DISCRIMINATING_FIXTURES.md
nodes.summary: Fixture registry for distinguishing competing cognitive hypotheses without automatically creating new primitives.
nodes.why_read: Open when a cognitive claim needs a bounded discriminating test or when checking whether an existing fixture already covers the question.

nodes.title: CLOS — Cognitive Availability / CASE E — 2026-09-04
nodes.summary: Scientific reconciliation of history-dependent cognitive availability: phenomenon supported, mechanism underdetermined, no new primitive authorized.
nodes.why_read: Open for the bounded evidence map on readiness/accessibility effects without explicit recollection and the underdetermined-mechanism boundary.
